chinese: 她每天早上七點起床。
reference: She gets up at seven o'clock every morning.

chinese: 昨天晚上下雨了，所以我們沒有去公園。
reference: It rained last night, so we didn't go to the park.

chinese: 這本書比那本書有趣多了。
reference: This book is much more interesting than that one.

chinese: 你可以借我一支筆嗎？
reference: Could you lend me a pen?

chinese: 我姊姊正在廚房裡煮晚餐。
reference: My sister is cooking dinner in the kitchen.

chinese: 我們應該在下課後打掃教室。
reference: We should clean the classroom after school.

chinese: 這是我看過最好看的電影。
reference: This is the best movie I have ever seen.

chinese: 如果明天天氣好，我們就去爬山。
reference: If it is sunny tomorrow, we will go hiking.

chinese: 她不僅聰明，而且很努力。
reference: She is not only smart but also hardworking.

chinese: 我到家的時候，我媽媽已經做好晚餐了。
reference: When I got home, my mother had already made dinner.

chinese: 明天我們將會去海邊游泳。
reference: We will go swimming at the beach tomorrow.

chinese: 她現在正在她的房間裡聽音樂。
reference: She is listening to music in her room now.

chinese: 因為下大雨，所以我們待在家裡。
reference: Because it rained heavily, we stayed at home.

chinese: 他已經去過日本三次了。
reference: He has been to Japan three times.

chinese: 每天運動對你的健康有益。
reference: Exercising every day is good for your health.

chinese: 為了通過考試，他每天熬夜。
reference: To pass the exam, he stays up late every day.

chinese: 這個袋子比那個重得多。
reference: This bag is much heavier than that one.

chinese: 冰箱裡有很多蘋果和一些牛奶。
reference: There are a lot of apples and some milk in the refrigerator.

chinese: 這支智慧型手機是在台灣製造的。
reference: This smartphone is made in Taiwan.

chinese: 當電話響起時，我正在洗澡。
reference: I was taking a bath when the phone rang.

chinese: 我每天花大約半小時走到學校。
reference: It takes me about half an hour to walk to school every day.

chinese: 你學英文學多久了？
reference: How long have you been learning English?

chinese: 我哥哥沒有我爸爸那麼高。
reference: My brother is not as tall as my father.

chinese: 請不要在圖書館裡講話。
reference: Please don't talk in the library.

chinese: 瑪麗是全班英文說得最好的人。
reference: Mary speaks English the best in the class.
